memories.title: Use SQLite WAL mode
memories.content: Enable WAL and a 5 second busy timeout so the CLI and MCP server can read and write the same database concurrently.

memories.title: No network listeners by default
memories.content: The service must never bind a TCP port unless the user opts in; MCP runs over stdio only.

memories.title: FTS5 query syntax injection
memories.content: Always quote each search token before passing it to MATCH, otherwise characters like a colon or a hyphen are parsed as FTS5 operators.

memories.title: Run the full check before committing
memories.content: Run cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy with warnings denied, then cargo test for the whole workspace.

memories.title: Optimistic concurrency for updates
memories.content: Updates carry expected_revision; a mismatch returns a conflict error and the caller must re-read before retrying.

memories.title: Never log memory bodies
memories.content: Logs go to stderr and must not contain memory content or secrets; stdout is reserved for command output.

memories.title: Cross-project reads leak existence
memories.content: Reading another project's memory must return not found, never a permission error, so ids cannot be probed.

memories.title: Jobs use leases with backoff
memories.content: Background jobs are leased for a limited time; failed attempts are retried with exponential backoff until they land in the dead letter.

memories.title: Retry a dead-lettered job
memories.content: After fixing the cause, run the jobs retry command with the job id to give it a fresh attempt budget.

memories.title: Ollama model must be pulled first
memories.content: Embedding or extraction fails with HTTP 404 when the model was not pulled on the local Ollama server.

memories.title: Redact secrets before storing events
memories.content: API keys, tokens and passwords are masked in captured agent events before they reach the database.

memories.title: Hook capture always exits zero
memories.content: The agent hook entry point swallows errors and exits 0 so a broken memory service can never block the coding agent.

memories.title: Candidates need human review
memories.content: Extracted knowledge becomes a candidate; nothing turns into a memory without a person accepting it.

memories.title: Resumed sessions are not extracted again
memories.content: A session that is resumed after extraction ran is not extracted again, so late events are missed until forced.

memories.title: Back up the database
memories.content: Copy the SQLite file together with its WAL and SHM files while no writer is running, or use the backup API.

memories.title: Never mix embedding dimensions
memories.content: Vectors from different embedding models or sizes must not coexist in one index; changing the model rebuilds it.

memories.title: Default data directory
memories.content: On macOS the database lives under ~/.local/share/chloe following XDG, not Application Support.

memories.title: Supersession is proposed, not automatic
memories.content: When a new memory replaces an old one, the system proposes a supersedes link and a person applies it.

memories.title: Add a new schema migration
memories.content: Create the next numbered SQL file in migrations and append it to the MIGRATIONS list; migrations are forward only.

memories.title: Canonicalize project paths
memories.content: Canonicalize project directories before hashing them, otherwise symlinks and worktrees create duplicate projects.

memories.title: 评测集固定不变
memories.content: 检索评测使用固定的记忆和查询，并由人工标注相关记忆，避免每次结果不可比较。

memories.title: 中文关键词只能整段匹配
memories.content: FTS 的 unicode61 分词器不会切分中文，查询词必须与整段连续文字一致才能命中。

memories.title: CI 构建缓存
memories.content: CI 中使用 cargo 缓存可以把构建时间从十分钟降到两分钟，但缓存键必须包含 Cargo.lock 的哈希。

memories.title: 发布流程
memories.content: 发布前先更新版本号和变更日志，打上标签，再由 CI 构建各平台的二进制并上传。

memories.title: 代码评审规则
memories.content: 每个合并请求至少需要一位评审者批准，并且所有检查通过之后才允许合并到主分支。

memories.title: 时区处理
memories.content: 数据库里的时间一律保存为 UTC 微秒，只有在展示给用户时才转换成本地时区。

memories.title: 导入任务内存泄漏
memories.content: 长时间运行的导入任务内存持续增长，原因是每批事件的缓冲区没有释放，需要在循环里清空。

memories.title: 配置优先级
memories.content: 配置的优先级依次是命令行参数、环境变量、配置文件、默认值。

memories.title: 错误码约定
memories.content: 所有对外错误使用固定的机器可读错误码，例如 not_found 和 conflict，便于脚本判断。

memories.title: 本地嵌入模型选择
memories.content: 嵌入模型选用 qwen3-embedding 0.6b，因为它体积小，并且同时覆盖中文和英文。

memories.title: 数据库损坏恢复
memories.content: 发现数据库损坏时，先停止所有进程，用 integrity_check 确认，再从最近的备份恢复。

memories.title: 测试数据隔离
memories.content: 测试必须使用临时目录和显式的数据库路径，绝不能碰用户真实的数据目录。

memories.title: 并发初始化冲突
memories.content: 两个进程同时初始化新数据库会出现 database is locked，需要在打开时重试几秒。

memories.title: 密钥管理
memories.content: 仓库里不允许提交任何密钥，凭据通过环境变量传入，扫描工具会在 CI 中拦截。

memories.title: 日志级别
memories.content: 默认日志级别是 info，调试时通过环境变量 CHLOE_LOG 调到 debug。

memories.title: 依赖升级
memories.content: 升级依赖时一次只升一个大版本，运行完整测试并查看变更日志，再合并。

memories.title: 会话采集范围
memories.content: 只采集用户提示、工具调用摘要和会话结束事件，不保存完整的终端输出。

memories.title: 性能基线
memories.content: 全文检索在一万条记忆上的 p95 延迟低于十毫秒，作为回归检查的基线。

memories.title: SQLite busy_timeout 设置
memories.content: 把 busy_timeout 设为 5 秒，这样多个 agent 同时写入时不会立刻报 SQLITE_BUSY。

memories.title: MCP 工具命名
memories.content: MCP 的工具统一用 memory_ 前缀，比如 memory_search 和 memory_save，方便 agent 识别。

memories.title: Docker 构建缓存
memories.content: Docker 镜像构建很慢是因为 COPY 放在依赖安装之前，应该先复制 Cargo.toml 再复制源码。

memories.title: Git worktree 项目识别
memories.content: 同一个仓库的多个 git worktree 要映射到同一个 project，否则记忆会被拆散。

memories.title: Redis 会话缓存
memories.content: 会话缓存放在 Redis 里，TTL 设置为 30 分钟，过期后需要重新登录。

memories.title: Rust 编译警告
memories.content: CI 里 clippy 的 warning 一律当作 error，本地提交前也要先跑 cargo clippy。

memories.title: GitHub Actions 矩阵
memories.content: 在 GitHub Actions 里用 matrix 同时测试 macOS 和 Linux，并缓存 ~/.cargo 目录。

memories.title: JSON schema 校验
memories.content: LLM 返回的内容必须通过 JSON schema 校验，不合法就丢弃，不能直接入库。

memories.title: Kubernetes 探针
memories.content: 服务部署在 Kubernetes 上时，liveness probe 调用 /healthz，readiness probe 调用 /ready。

memories.title: OAuth token 刷新
memories.content: OAuth 的 access token 一小时过期，必须用 refresh token 自动刷新，否则长任务会 401。

memories.title: PostgreSQL 建索引
memories.content: 给大表加索引要用 CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY，避免锁表阻塞线上写入。

memories.title: Tokio 阻塞调用
memories.content: 在 tokio 的异步任务里调用阻塞的文件 IO 会卡住 executor，应放到 spawn_blocking。

memories.title: HTTP client retries
memories.content: Calls to the model server retry twice with a short delay; longer outages are left to the job queue backoff.

memories.title: Vacuum after bulk deletes
memories.content: Run VACUUM after deleting many rows; it needs free disk space about the size of the database.

memories.title: Schema version numbering
memories.content: schema_version is a single integer in PRAGMA user_version and is never reused or decreased.

memories.title: Naming feature branches
memories.content: Feature branches are named feature/<ticket>-<slug> and deleted after merge.

memories.title: Time zone in logs
memories.content: Log timestamps are RFC 3339 in UTC; do not format them in local time.

memories.title: Docs site hosting
memories.content: The documentation site is built from the docs directory and published by CI on every tag.

memories.title: Large pasted prompts
memories.content: Prompts over 64 KiB are truncated before capture to keep events small.

memories.title: Rust edition
memories.content: The workspace uses Rust edition 2024 and shares dependency versions in the root manifest.

memories.title: No unsafe code
memories.content: unsafe is forbidden in every crate through a workspace lint.

memories.title: Embedding request size
memories.content: Embeddings are requested one memory per call to keep error handling simple.

memories.title: Status values
memories.content: A memory is active, disputed, superseded or archived; search returns only active by default.

memories.title: Inspect a failing job
memories.content: Use jobs show with the job id to read its last error and next run time.

memories.title: Stdout is for results
memories.content: Anything printed to stdout in MCP mode corrupts the protocol; use stderr.

memories.title: Hook payload size
memories.content: Hook payloads are capped at 1 MiB; larger ones are dropped and counted.

memories.title: Local-first defaults
memories.content: No telemetry and no cloud calls by default; remote providers need an explicit flag.

memories.title: Run a single test
memories.content: Use cargo test -p memory-store with a test name filter to run one test.

memories.title: Windows line endings
memories.content: Normalize CRLF to LF in captured text before hashing for idempotency keys.

memories.title: Candidate states
memories.content: A candidate is pending, accepted, rejected or merged.

memories.title: Evidence on every candidate
memories.content: Each candidate keeps the event ids it came from so a reviewer can check the source.

memories.title: Clock skew
memories.content: Lease expiry uses the caller's clock; a machine with a wrong clock can reclaim jobs early.

memories.title: Snippet limit
memories.content: Search results cut each body to 1000 characters; memory_get returns the whole text.

memories.title: Memory size limits
memories.content: Titles are at most 200 characters and bodies at most 64 KiB.

memories.title: Rebuild the full-text index
memories.content: Run doctor --reindex to rebuild the FTS index when the consistency check fails.

memories.title: Idempotent import
memories.content: Importing the hook spool twice yields the same events because each has a stable key.

memories.title: Supported agents
memories.content: Claude Code and Codex are supported through hooks; other agents can use MCP only.

memories.title: 构建产物目录
memories.content: 编译产物放在 target 目录，已加入 gitignore，不要提交。

memories.title: 分析慢查询
memories.content: 分析慢查询时先用 EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN 看是否走了索引，再决定是否加索引。

memories.title: 接口兼容
memories.content: MCP 工具的参数只增不删，新增字段必须有默认值，旧客户端不受影响。

memories.title: 文档站点
memories.content: 文档站点由 CI 在每次打标签时构建并发布。

memories.title: 重试上限
memories.content: 任务最多尝试五次，之后进入死信队列。

memories.title: 命名规范
memories.content: Rust 代码使用蛇形命名，类型使用大驼峰，常量全大写。

memories.title: 代码覆盖率
memories.content: 核心 crate 的行覆盖率目标是百分之八十，低于目标不阻塞合并。

memories.title: 字符串截断
memories.content: 按字节截断中文会产生乱码，必须按字符边界截断。

memories.title: 审计记录
memories.content: 每次修改记忆都会追加一条修订记录，修订表不允许更新或删除。

memories.title: 超时设置
memories.content: 调用本地模型的超时默认是两分钟，嵌入查询是五秒。

memories.title: 合并去重
memories.content: 相似度很高的重复候选会被自动合并，冲突的候选标记为待人工处理。

memories.title: 提示词语言
memories.content: 抽取提示词使用英文，输出字段保持英文枚举。

memories.title: 状态取值
memories.content: 记忆状态有四种：活跃、争议、被取代和已归档。

memories.title: JSON 输出格式
memories.content: 命令行的 --json 输出使用蛇形字段名，时间为 RFC 3339。

memories.title: 安装方式
memories.content: 用 cargo install --path crates/memory-cli 安装 chloe 命令。

memories.title: MCP 客户端配置
memories.content: 在 Claude Code 里用 claude mcp add 注册 chloe，Codex 则写入 config.toml。

memories.title: Ollama 默认地址
memories.content: Ollama 默认监听 127.0.0.1:11434，非本机地址必须加 --allow-remote。

memories.title: RRF 融合参数
memories.content: 混合检索用 RRF 融合 FTS 和向量两路 top-50，k 取 60。

memories.title: Unicode 规范化
memories.content: 全角和半角字符在 FTS 里是不同的 token，查询前不会自动归一化。

memories.title: UUID 主键
memories.content: memories 表用 UUID 字符串做主键，外键开启 foreign_keys=ON。

memories.title: CI 超时
memories.content: GitHub Actions 的单个 job 超时设为 20 分钟，超时按失败处理。

memories.title: SQLite 页缓存
memories.content: SQLite 的 cache_size 保持默认值，目前没有测出需要调大。

memories.title: Homebrew 安装 Ollama
memories.content: macOS 上用 brew install ollama，然后 ollama pull 需要的模型。

memories.title: LLM 温度
memories.content: 抽取任务的 temperature 固定为 0，保证同一输入输出可复现。

memories.title: stdio 传输
memories.content: MCP 通过 stdio 传输 JSON-RPC，每条消息占一行。
